mapper.sql: d.id, d.device_code as deviceCode, d.device_name as deviceName, d.category, d.lab_id as labId, coalesce(d.lab_name, l.lab_name) as labName, d.location, d.owner_user_id as ownerUserId, coalesce(u.real_name, u.username) as ownerUsername, coalesce(d.quantity, 1) as quantity, coalesce(d.unit, '台') as unit, d.status, d.health, d.online, d.specs, d.standard_requirement as standardRequirement, d.remark, d.source_type as sourceType, d.purchase_date as purchaseDate, d.inventory_date as inventoryDate, d.warranty_date as warrantyDate, d.usage_hours as usageHours, d.maintenance, coalesce(d.deleted, 0) as deleted, d.created_at as createdAt, d.updated_at as updatedAt
from device d left join lab l on d.lab_id = l.id left join sys_user u on u.id = d.owner_user_id
mapper.insert: insert into device ( device_code, device_name, category, lab_id, lab_name, location, owner_user_id, quantity, unit, status, health, online, specs, standard_requirement, remark, source_type, purchase_date, inventory_date, warranty_date, usage_hours, maintenance, deleted ) values( #{deviceCode}, #{deviceName}, #{category}, #{labId}, #{labName}, #{location}, #{ownerUserId}, #{quantity}, #{unit}, #{status}, #{health}, #{online}, #{specs}, #{standardRequirement}, #{remark}, #{sourceType}, #{purchaseDate}, #{inventoryDate}, #{warrantyDate}, #{usageHours}, #{maintenance}, coalesce(#{deleted}, 0) )
mapper.update: update device set device_code = #{devices.deviceCode}, device_name = #{devices.deviceName}, category = #{devices.category}, lab_id = #{devices.labId}, lab_name = #{devices.labName}, location = #{devices.location}, owner_user_id = #{devices.ownerUserId}, quantity = #{devices.quantity}, unit = #{devices.unit}, status = #{devices.status}, health = #{devices.health}, online = #{devices.online}, specs = #{devices.specs}, standard_requirement = #{devices.standardRequirement}, remark = #{devices.remark}, source_type = #{devices.sourceType}, purchase_date = #{devices.purchaseDate}, inventory_date = #{devices.inventoryDate}, warranty_date = #{devices.warrantyDate}, usage_hours = #{devices.usageHours}, maintenance = #{devices.maintenance}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and coalesce(deleted, 0) = 0

update device set status = #{status}, maintenance = trim(concat(coalesce(maintenance, ''), '\n', #{maintenance})), updated_at = now() where coalesce(deleted, 0) = 0 and (device_name = #{device} or device_code = #{device})
update device set inventory_date = #{inventoryDate}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and coalesce(deleted, 0) = 0
update device set lab_id = #{labId}, location = #{location}, owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and coalesce(deleted, 0) = 0
update device set deleted = 1, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
select
where coalesce(d.deleted, 0) = 0 order by d.created_at desc, d.id desc

select count(1) as total, sum(case when status = '正常' then 1 else 0 end) as normal, sum(case when status = '维修中' then 1 else 0 end) as repairing, sum(case when status = '闲置' then 1 else 0 end) as idle, sum(case when status = '已报废' then 1 else 0 end) as scrapped from device where coalesce(deleted, 0) = 0

select
where d.lab_id = #{labId} and coalesce(d.deleted, 0) = 0 order by d.created_at desc, d.id desc
